dedupe_keys.name: ores open data walloon electricity and gas distribution consumption decentralised production smart meters and social supply statistics

description: ORES, an electricity and gas distribution system operator in Wallonia, publishes a series of 33 open datasets on the Open Data Wallonie-Bruxelles portal. They cover electricity and gas consumption by locality, customer type, voltage level and business sector, annual and quarterly; the number and power of decentralised production units and injected energy by production type; offtake points; smart and budget meters; public lighting luminaires by municipality; EV charging point declarations; example quarter-hourly load curves; and public service obligation statistics such as protected customers and customers served by the social supplier. The handed-off example, dataset 017, counts distribution customers by supplier type (commercial or social) per energy, geographical sector and locality, with 7,604 records, CC0 licence and a last modification on 18 December 2025; geographical sectors follow the former intermunicipal territories. Data are available for free download in CSV, JSON, Parquet, shapefile and RDF formats and through the explore API. Coverage is the ORES territory in Wallonia, Belgium. Caveats: descriptions are in French, figures are aggregated by locality, and ORES asks to be told of reuses. Simulation uses are local demand, distributed generation and smart meter penetration for distribution planning and energy poverty analysis. Related records: data-odre-open-data-reseaux-energies is the French counterpart platform.
